# R-501 Monomer Feed Phase: Control Narrative (Draft A, 2026-10-18)

Built from the request text only. I did not read the instrument index, C&E chart, or recipe. Items I could not source are marked TBD and listed in section 10.

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

| ID | Requirement | FAT test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-R501-001 | The phase shall feed monomer to R-501 at the recipe rate until the recipe total is reached. | Run the phase in simulation. Compare the totalizer to SL-02. |
| FR-R501-002 | The phase shall stop the feed when the reaction does not consume the monomer. | Simulate loss of consumption. Confirm Hold. |
| FR-R501-003 | The phase shall keep temperature control and agitation active in every state, including Held, Stopped, and Aborted. | Trigger each state. Check TIC-505, TIC-506, and A-501. |

- **Upstream:** monomer supply and feed isolation valve (tags TBD, OI-02).
- **Downstream:** the next recipe phase, set by the recipe.
- **Recipe interface:** the recipe supplies SL-01, SL-02, and SL-06.
- **Out of scope:** the 95 C trip is an SIS function. Refer to the SIS SRS.

## 2. Equipment and setpoint list

The instrument index is the source for tag data. Do not copy it here.

| Tag | Role in this phase |
|---|---|
| FIC-510 | Monomer feed flow control. Totalizer tag TBD (OI-02). |
| TIC-505 | Reaction temperature, master of the cascade |
| TIC-506 | Jacket temperature, slave. Split-ranges TV-506A (cooling water) and TV-506B (steam). |
| A-501 / SI-501 | Agitator and its speed sensor |

**Setpoint list.** This is the single source for every number in this narrative.

| ID | Item | Value | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| SL-01 | Feed rate (FIC-510 SP) | Recipe parameter (typical 1.2 m3/h) | Process |
| SL-02 | Feed total | Recipe parameter | Process |
| SL-03 | Expected feed time | About 4 h (information only, not used by logic) | Process |
| SL-04 | Initiation quantity | TBD | Process |
| SL-05 | Feed ramp time | TBD | Process |
| SL-06 | TIC-505 SP | 80 C (recipe parameter) | Process |
| SL-07 | TAH-505 alarm | 88 C (alarm database owns the value) | Alarm lead |
| SL-08 | SIS trip | 95 C (SRS owns the value, information only) | Safety lead |
| SL-09 | TIC-505 deviation limit and delay | TBD | Process |
| SL-10 | A-501 minimum speed | TBD | Process |
| SL-11 | SI-501 disagreement delay | TBD | Controls |
| SL-12 | Accumulation limit | TBD (hazard review) | Safety lead |
| SL-13 | Minimum consumption indication and delay | TBD (hazard review) | Process |
| SL-14 | TIC-506 SP high and low limits | TBD | Process |
| SL-15 | Split-range break point | TBD | Controls |
| SL-16 | Safe jacket SP for bad TIC-505 PV | TBD | Process |
| SL-17 | Step timeouts (one per step) | TBD | Controls |
| SL-18 | Minimum hold time after power loss | TBD | Process |
| SL-19 | Feed total tolerance | TBD | Process |

## 3. States and transitions

The phase uses the ISA-88 state model. Automation level is Automatic unless the table says otherwise.

| State | Entry condition | Allowed exits | Initiator |
|---|---|---|---|
| Idle | Reset from Complete, Stopped, or Aborted | Running | Operator or batch (needs permissives PM-1 to PM-7) |
| Running | Start, or Restarting complete | Holding, Stopping, Aborting, Complete | Auto (Hold causes in 3.1), operator, or batch |
| Holding | Hold command or hold cause | Held, Stopping, Aborting | Auto, operator |
| Held | Feed closed and confirmed | Restarting, Stopping, Aborting | Operator-prompted |
| Restarting | Operator restart with PM-1 to PM-7 and PM-8 true | Running, Holding, Aborting | Operator-prompted |
| Stopping | Stop command | Stopped, Aborting | Operator or batch |
| Aborting | Abort command, or any state | Aborted | Operator, batch, or auto |
| Complete | Feed total reached | Idle (reset) | Auto |
| Stopped / Aborted | Actions finished | Idle (reset) | Operator |

**Permissives** (verified at start and at restart):

| ID | Permissive |
|---|---|
| PM-1 | SI-501 shows A-501 at or above SL-10. |
| PM-2 | TIC-505 and TIC-506 are in cascade. |
| PM-3 | TIC-505 is within SL-09 of SL-06. |
| PM-4 | Cooling water is available (tag TBD). |
| PM-5 | No SIS trip is active. |
| PM-6 | Recipe parameters SL-01, SL-02, and SL-06 are valid. |
| PM-7 | Monomer supply is available (tag TBD). |
| PM-8 | The accumulation indicator is below SL-12 (restart only). |

**State actions:**

| ID | State | Action | FAT test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-R501-010 | Holding, Stopping | Set FIC-510 to manual at zero output. Close the feed isolation valve. Leave TIC-505, TIC-506, and A-501 unchanged. | Command each state. Check feed closed and loops unchanged. |
| FR-R501-011 | Aborting | Close the feed isolation valve immediately. Set FIC-510 output to zero. Leave TIC-505, TIC-506, and A-501 unchanged. | Command Abort. Measure feed isolation time. |
| FR-R501-012 | Held, Stopped, Aborted | Keep the feed closed. Report the remaining quantity (SL-02 minus the totalizer) to the batch system. | Check the reported value after each state. |
| FR-R501-013 | Restarting | Resume from the remaining quantity. Ramp FIC-510 over SL-05. | Hold at mid-feed, then restart. Check the total and the ramp. |
| FR-R501-014 | Any | Do not stop A-501 from this phase. | Command all states. Check that A-501 stays on. |

### 3.1 Hold causes

Interlock logic belongs in the C&E chart. This list gives only the phase response.

| ID | Cause | Response | FAT test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-R501-020 | Accumulation indicator above SL-12 | Hold | Force the indicator above the limit. |
| FR-R501-021 | Consumption indication below SL-13 for the SL-13 delay while feeding | Hold | Force low heat release. |
| FR-R501-022 | TAH-505 active (SL-07) | Hold | Force TIC-505 PV high. |
| FR-R501-023 | TIC-505 deviation from SP beyond SL-09 | Hold | Force the deviation. |
| FR-R501-024 | SI-501 below SL-10, or SI-501 disagrees with the A-501 run status for SL-11 | Hold | Force low speed. |
| FR-R501-025 | Cooling water unavailable (PM-4 false) | Hold | Force PM-4 false. |
| FR-R501-026 | Bad PV on FIC-510, TIC-505, TIC-506, or SI-501 | Hold | Force each bad PV. |
| FR-R501-027 | Step timeout (SL-17) | Hold | Block each step condition. |

## 4. Regulatory control

| ID | Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-R501-030 | FIC-510 | Feed flow | Feed control valve (tag per index) | Reverse-acting flow loop | AUTO in Running. Manual at zero in Holding, Stopping, Aborting. |
| FR-R501-031 | TIC-505 | Reactor temperature | Remote SP of TIC-506 | Reverse: PV above SP lowers the jacket SP | Cascade in all states. |
| FR-R501-032 | TIC-506 | Jacket temperature | Split range: TV-506A cooling, TV-506B steam | Cooling demand opens TV-506A. Heating demand opens TV-506B. Break point is SL-15. | Cascade in all states. SP limited to SL-14. |

Do not open TV-506A and TV-506B together. Fail positions of both valves are in the instrument index (OI-05).

## 5. Sequences

### 5.1 Running (feed sequence)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check PM-1 to PM-7. | All true | SL-17 | Hold |
| 2 | Set FIC-510 SP to zero. Confirm TIC-505 SP equals SL-06. | TIC-505 within SL-09 | SL-17 | Hold |
| 3 | Open the feed isolation valve. | Valve confirmed open | SL-17 | Hold |
| 4 | Feed the initiation quantity (SL-04) at SL-01. | Totalizer reaches SL-04 | SL-17 | Hold |
| 5 | Wait for consumption indication. | Indication above SL-13 | SL-17 | Hold. Do not restart without operator review. |
| 6 | Ramp FIC-510 to SL-01 over SL-05. | FIC-510 at SL-01 | SL-17 | Hold |
| 7 | Feed until the totalizer reaches SL-02. | Totalizer at SL-02 (within SL-19) | SL-17 | Hold |
| 8 | Set FIC-510 to zero. Close the feed isolation valve. | Valve confirmed closed | SL-17 | Hold |
| 9 | Report Complete. | | | |

FR-R501-040: Steps 4 and 5 limit the monomer fed before the reaction starts. The values SL-04 and SL-13 need approval from the hazard review. Test: simulate no reaction at step 5 and confirm Hold.

### 5.2 Accumulation monitoring

FR-R501-041: In Running and Restarting, the controller shall calculate an accumulation indicator (tag TBD). The indicator is monomer fed minus monomer consumed. Consumption comes from the reaction heat release. Test: step the simulated heat release to zero and check that the indicator rises and causes Hold at SL-12.

The cooling duty calculation needs jacket flow and inlet and outlet temperatures. The request lists none of these instruments (OI-01).

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

Interlock logic is in the C&E chart (reference TBD). Do not restate it here. The 95 C trip and its final elements are in the SIS SRS. The BPCS phase does not take credit for the SIS.

## 7. Alarms

The rationalized alarm database lists all alarms. The phase shall raise a Hold-reason message for each cause in 3.1. TAH-505 (SL-07) is already in the alarm database.

## 8. Abnormal handling

| ID | Event | Response | FAT test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-R501-050 | FIC-510 bad PV | Close the feed (Hold). | Force bad PV. |
| FR-R501-051 | TIC-505 bad PV | Hold. Set TIC-506 to local SP at SL-16. | Force bad PV. |
| FR-R501-052 | TIC-506 bad PV | Hold. Operator takes manual control of TV-506A/B. | Force bad PV. |
| FR-R501-053 | SI-501 bad PV | Treat the agitator as not proven. Hold. | Force bad PV. |
| FR-R501-054 | Comms loss, I/O to controller | Close the feed. Go to Hold on recovery. | Pull the I/O link. |
| FR-R501-055 | Comms loss, batch server or HMI | The phase continues. Hold if the loss continues past the TBD delay (OI-06). | Pull the server link. |
| FR-R501-056 | Power loss and restart | Start in Held. Feed closed. Do not auto-restart. Treat monomer accumulation as unknown. Enforce SL-18 before restart. | Cycle power mid-feed. |
| FR-R501-057 | A-501 stops | Hold. Do not restart A-501 automatically. The operator decides after review. | Stop A-501 in Running. |

Valve fail positions come from the instrument index (OI-05).

## 9. Operator interface

| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| Display | Phase state, SL-01 and actual flow, totalizer and remaining quantity, TIC-505, TIC-506, SI-501, accumulation indicator, Hold reason |
| Operator can change | Start, Hold, Restart, Stop, Abort. Feed rate within the recipe limits. |
| Prompt: reaction not started | "Reaction has not started. Do not restart the feed. Call the process engineer." |
| Prompt: restart | "Check TIC-505 and the accumulation indicator. Push RESTART to continue the feed." |
| Prompt: agitator stop | "A-501 stopped. Do not start A-501 until the process engineer approves." |

Operations must sign off on states and prompts.

| OI-03 | Fill in the TBD values in the setpoint list. | Process | 2026-11-30 |
| OI-04 | Approve the initiation quantity and reaction-start step. | Process, Safety lead | 2026-11-15 |
| OI-05 | Confirm fail positions of TV-506A, TV-506B, and the feed valve. | Controls lead | 2026-11-01 |
| OI-06 | Define the comms-loss delay. | Controls lead | 2026-11-15 |
| OI-07 | Confirm that A-501 stays on in all states. Check whether a restart after an agitator stop is safe. | Safety lead | 2026-11-15 |
| OI-08 | Decide whether to hold before TAH-505 (a TIC-505 deviation limit lower than SL-07). | Process | 2026-11-15 |
